title: Co-op player 2 feel, blind, three rounds with goblins (DPC 0.9.177-dev21)
intro: About 7 minutes, two controllers. Player 2's pawn, melee then mage, three rounds each against goblins that can't die. Rank the rounds per part.

probes.errs: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'dev_status/DirectPawnControl.json'); return ok and d and d.errors
probes.coop: local ok, d = pcall(json.load_file, 'DPC_coop.json'); return ok and d and d.active == true
probes.who: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return s and s.active and tostring(s.pawn_name) or 'Arisen'
probes.fix: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; if not D then return '' end; if D.cfg.pawn_prev_state == false then return 'off' end; return D.cfg.pawn_prev_move == false and 'nomove' or 'full'
probes.pf: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.pipfix_n or 0
probes.dpc_cancels: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; return D and D.R.cancel_n or 0
probes.n0: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc) or ''
probes.n1: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; return pc and H.node(pc, 1) or ''
probes.sk: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; local ok,v=pcall(function() return pc:call('get_Human'):call('get_CustomSkillState') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.on: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; local ok, v = pcall(function() return s.pawn_input:get_field('ButtonOnFlags') end); return ok and v or 0
probes.yaw: local D=_G.DPC_dbg; local s=D and D.state; local pc=s and s.pawn_chara; local ok, v = pcall(function() local q = pc:call('get_Transform'):call('get_Rotation'); return math.deg(math.atan(2*(q.w*q.y + q.x*q.z), 1 - 2*(q.y*q.y + q.x*q.x))) end); return ok and v or 0

steps.text: Starting
CO-OP: start co-op with player 2 on a melee pawn (L3+R3 on their controller). Press End when both are in.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2) ROUND 1 of 3: three goblins that can't die are coming. Press End when you're ready (40 s).
CO-OP MELEE (player 2) ROUND 1: player 2 fights: combos, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2): remember how round 1 felt (1 / 2 / 3). Press End.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2) ROUND 2 of 3: three goblins that can't die are coming. Press End when you're ready (40 s).
CO-OP MELEE (player 2) ROUND 2: player 2 fights: combos, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2): remember how round 2 felt (1 / 2 / 3). Press End.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2) ROUND 3 of 3: three goblins that can't die are coming. Press End when you're ready (40 s).
CO-OP MELEE (player 2) ROUND 3: player 2 fights: combos, attacks into skills, skills into jump / dodge, guard.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2): remember how round 3 felt (1 / 2 / 3). Press End.
CO-OP MELEE (player 2): which round felt best, which worst? Tell Claude after the test. Press End.
CO-OP: player 2 switches to the Mage / Sorcerer pawn (L1 + left stick click). Press End when ready.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2) ROUND 1 of 3: three goblins that can't die are coming. Press End when you're ready (40 s).
CO-OP MAGE (player 2) ROUND 1: player 2 fights with spells: aim, cast, L2 cancel mid-chant, cancel into a dodge.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2): remember how round 1 felt (1 / 2 / 3). Press End.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2) ROUND 2 of 3: three goblins that can't die are coming. Press End when you're ready (40 s).
CO-OP MAGE (player 2) ROUND 2: player 2 fights with spells: aim, cast, L2 cancel mid-chant, cancel into a dodge.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2): remember how round 2 felt (1 / 2 / 3). Press End.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2) ROUND 3 of 3: three goblins that can't die are coming. Press End when you're ready (40 s).
CO-OP MAGE (player 2) ROUND 3: player 2 fights with spells: aim, cast, L2 cancel mid-chant, cancel into a dodge.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2): remember how round 3 felt (1 / 2 / 3). Press End.
CO-OP MAGE (player 2): which round felt best, which worst? Tell Claude after the test. Press End.
Done: fix back on, test goblins removed. Tell Claude your picks.
